name: lkdf-monorepo
description: LKDF — Game Thẻ Bài Tam Quốc Sát (Windows Native Online 4–8 Người)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@lkdf/server && npm run build --workspace=@lkdf/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@lkdf/server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@lkdf/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,desktop -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@lkdf/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@lkdf/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@lkdf/desktop"
